owner: CUT owns request orchestration and records; INT-10 owns SMS/EMAIL Provider; INT-05 owns DINGTALK Provider

requestExactFields.tenantId: positive Long equal to trusted TenantContext
requestExactFields.recipientUserId: positive Long frozen on the active approval node
requestExactFields.taskLink: non-blank internal platform route without external contact data

resultUnion.ACCEPTED: providerReferenceId non-blank String 1..128 and acceptedAt server timestamp
resultUnion.EXPLICIT_FAILURE: stable errorCode non-blank String 1..64; retryable=true and no providerReferenceId

errorBoundary.providerUnavailable: treated as EXPLICIT_FAILURE for this delivery record and scheduled for retry; never escapes into or rolls back an already committed approval command
errorBoundary.invalidRequestOrOwnerCorruption: moves the record to PENDING_RETRY with stable errorCode,retryCount,nextRetryAt,lastAttemptAt and retries with the same deliveryKey; never remains immediately claimable PENDING, never records success and never creates a new intent
errorBoundary.forbidden: CUT never accepts phone, email address, DingTalk account, access token or provider secret

delivery.creation: initial PENDING activation, next-node WAITING-to-PENDING activation, and reassignment of the current PENDING node append exactly one record per channel after the mandatory IN_PLATFORM record; reassignment of a still-WAITING node appends no notification, and its later activation uses the then-current recipient and nodeVersion
delivery.claim: stable by tenantId,dueAt,id with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED; version CAS
delivery.retry: PENDING or PENDING_RETRY reuses the same deliveryKey; explicit failure uses server backoff; DELIVERY_UNKNOWN is excluded from automatic claim
delivery.idempotency: unique tenantId+deliveryKey; approval-command replay produces no new record

controlledSubstitute: src/test may supply deterministic accepted/failure/unknown results and prove the CUT positive loop; no production Fake/fallback/empty-success bean
productionBoundary: until INT-10/INT-05 Providers exist, the external delivery Job remains PAUSED; the existing IN_PLATFORM delivery remains active and authoritative for the platform todo
